verdict.rationale: There is no first-class bulk-operations feature in the evidence. Bulk-style work is only implied through other tools: Terraform for "managing fleets of agents at scale," the CLI for managing entity tags and searching entities across all accounts, and NerdGraph for configuring features programmatically. These let users script operations across many items, but nothing documents native batch actions. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API or UI operations (e.g., bulk tagging or bulk editing of alerts/dashboards), documentation of batch semantics or limits, and hands-on corroboration.
